prompt_en: Create a photorealistic Republic of Korea Armed Forces special-warfare promotional poster of the same unmistakably adult woman from the original reference portrait. Preserve her long oval face, eye aperture and spacing, jaw width, nose, lips, natural skin texture, and long dark wavy hair. Show only her upper body, framed from mid-torso upward. She shoulders a compact carbine and aims it straight toward the camera, both gloved hands controlling the weapon with a firm cheek weld. The barrel bore faces the lens head-on; muzzle and front sight dominate the foreground while her focused face stays visible above the optic. The camera is aligned with the bore axis just below her eye line. Muzzle, optic, and face form one disciplined central depth stack. Her trigger finger lies indexed straight along the receiver. Helmet, headset, rain-darkened uniform, plate carrier, pouches, and Republic of Korea flag patch remain coherent. A wet training compound blurs behind her. Warm rim light catches her face, helmet, and rain through cool storm haze. The result reads as premium national-defense campaign key art: tense, controlled, capable, decisive.
